hash_contract: batch_stream_sha256 = SHA256(concatenation in step order of the 32 raw bytes decoded from each logged batch_sha256); per-array hash is SHA256 of C-order raw array bytes, with shape/dtype recorded separately.
limits: Metadata and compressed NPZ file bytes need not match between model families; the eight numeric initial arrays were compared byte-for-byte.
A changed parameter array means at least one element changed; each array also has a recorded positive gradient on at least one update. Element-level counts are retained.
This audit checks complete logged batch-hash sequences and checkpoint bytes, not a replay of all 300 generated batches.
Receipt test-evaluation counters are checked as records; this audit does not independently reconstruct every external process that may have run.
Secondary runs are still in progress and are excluded from this primary audit.
scope: Primary 54 completed training runs only. Read-only existing training evidence; no datasets regenerated, no fitting/evaluation performed, no test data or test metrics read.
